description: List all deployments with their URLs, status, labels, and password protection state. The response's `cursor` is null on the last page; pass it back as `cursor` to fetch the next.

cursor.description: Opaque position from the previous response's `cursor` field; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in one page. Omit for the server default.

name: deployments_list

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page. The whole has-more signal.

config.description: True if the deployment includes a ship.json routing config.

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the deployment was created.

expires.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the deployment expires; null when permanent. Anonymous deployments expire 3 days after creation unless claimed; an authenticated deployment carries one only when it requested a ttl.

files.description: Number of files in the deployment.

labels.description: Labels attached to the deployment; empty when none.

password.description: True if the deployment is password-protected.

screenshot.description: Full URL to the deployment screenshot. Rendered on the first request for it, so the URL is returned immediately and the first request takes a few seconds; every request after that is served immediately.

status.description: Deployment lifecycle state; "success" means the site is live. One of: pending, success, failed, deleting.

url.description: Full URL to the live deployment.

via.description: How the deployment was created, as shown in deployment history (today one of: web, sdk, cli, mcp, git, n8n, gpt, vsc, cld, crs, gmn, api). Null on deployments older than the tag.

title: List Deployments
